ops.title: Update capt-hook models pack for Opus 5 lane recalibration
ops.description:
The fleet Models table (plugin/guides/md/claude-rules.md, 2026-07-25) moved individual bounded, decision-light implementation from gpt-5.6-sol back to opus-5 (Opus 5: Coding Agent Index tie with sol, output $25 vs $30/MTok, effort-dependent efficiency — bounded lanes may run `high`). Sol keeps the N-unit sweep lane, review/refuter, security audit, diagnosis, second opinions, rote/imagegen.

The capt-hook `models` pack (external builtin, lives in the capt-hook repo) still nudges "well-scoped, clearly-bounded implementation routes to gpt-5.6-sol" in its Fable-implementation nudge. Until updated, its live nudges contradict the new table. The updated spec wording is in plugins/repo-bootstrap/skills/repo-bootstrap/reference/hooks.md (models pack section): implementation defaults to opus (`xhigh`, or `high` when bounded and decision-light); repetitive bounded sweeps plus terminal-heavy execution route to gpt-5.6-sol. Review/diagnosis nudges are unchanged.

ops.text: The models pack Fable-implementation nudge routes bounded decision-light implementation to opus (high effort) and only sweeps/terminal-heavy work to gpt-5.6-sol
Pack wording matches reference/hooks.md's models section in cc-skills
